instruction: Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.

target.reason: The instruction ends with Glitch plugging the data-shard into his deck and cracking its contents, but the page offers no verb for using, plugging in, or cracking an item (only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, refuse), and none of the available end states (holding, location, having spoken, knowing a location or holder) captures a cracked shard. At most Glitch could come to hold the data-shard by getting Rogue to offer it and accepting it, which is only a precondition of the instruction, not the end it wants.
